name: scheduler
description: Editable agent schedules: RRULE recurrences owned by a user or an agent_view, shared, run by the framework tick

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a recurring schedule that runs a prompt in this agent_view

tools.name: schedule_update
tools.description: Change a schedule this agent may reach

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.description: List the schedules this agent may reach, with their next fire time

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.description: Delete a schedule this agent may reach
